text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Achieving a magnificent Triple Tiara, 
Mejiro Dober etched a new chapter in 
history!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though tears of joy threaten to spill,
she 
composes herself, carrying herself with 
the majestic poise befitting a new queen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward,
Mejiro Dober once again thanked 
the Trainer for believing in her
strength, 
taking her first step toward her next 
challenge...!
